image_description: A male brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a white bird feeder tray. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and black upperparts with white wing bars. It is facing right, eating seeds. A second, out-of-focus bird is visible in the background to the left.
